predecessors.name: Lordship of Milan
predecessors.text: the Visconti lordship of Milan and Pavia, raised to a duchy in 1395: Lombardy, the Ossola, the Valtellina and the Ticino valley in Cliopatria's 1402 outline

successors.name: Kingdom of Spain
successors.text: Francesco II Sforza died without heirs in 1535; Charles V, claiming the duchy as an imperial fief, took control and invested his son Philip with it by a diploma signed in Brussels on 11 October 1540

ledger.x: 1395: Gian Galeazzo Visconti becomes the first Duke of Milan.
1399: Gian Galeazzo becomes lord of Pisa.
1402: Gian Galeazzo dies and the Visconti state breaks up.
ledger.cp: Visconti heirs' lordships (Filippo Maria, Gabriele Maria)

ledger.x: 1402: Gian Galeazzo's lordship of Pisa ends with his death.
1421: Milan takes Genoa.
1426: Venice joins Florence against Milan and the war reaches Brescia.
1426: the Peace of Venice gives Brescia to Venice.
1429: Venice governs Bergamo and Crema.
1433: the Peace of Ferrara ends the first Venetian war.
1440: Uri conquers the Leventina.
1441: Milan recognises Genoa's independence.
1447: Filippo Maria dies and Milan becomes a republic.
1450: Francesco Sforza becomes ruler of Milan and restores the duchy.
1453: Lodi and Piacenza are Milan's again.
1464: Milan conquers Genoa under Francesco Sforza.
1478: Genoa leaves Sforza rule.
1488: Ludovico Sforza's Milan takes Genoa again.
1499: Louis XII of France conquers Milan.
1512: Swiss troops put Maximilian Sforza on the ducal throne.
1513: the Swiss make Milan their protectorate.
1515: Marignano ends the Swiss protectorate.
1515: the French take Milan after Marignano.
1521: Lautrec is driven out of Milan.
1524: the French re-enter Milan.
1525: Pavia ends the French hold on Milan.
1526: Imperial troops take Milan from Sforza.
1529: Sforza returns to Milan after the Treaty of Cambrai.
1535: Francesco II Sforza dies without heirs and Charles V takes the duchy.

wars.name: Wars in Lombardy
wars.outcome: Venice took Brescia (Peace of Venice, 30 December 1426) and governed Bergamo and Crema from 1429; the Peace of Ferrara (May 1433) froze the front; the Peace of Cremona (20 November 1441) freed Genoa; the Treaty of Lodi (April 1454) ended the wars with Sforza…

wars.name: Louis XII's conquest of Milan
wars.outcome: Louis XII drove out Ludovico il Moro in 1499 and held the duchy until 1512; Ludovico was defeated and captured at Novara in 1500.

wars.name: War of the League of Cambrai
wars.outcome: The French lost Milan in 1512, Maximilian Sforza ruled under the Swiss from 29 December 1512, the French returned after Marignano (13-14 September 1515) and took Milan on 4 October 1515; the Treaty of Noyon (August 1516) and the Treaty of Brussels (6 December…

wars.name: Italian War of 1521-1526
wars.outcome: Lautrec lost Milan in late November 1521, the French re-entered it on 26 October 1524 and lost it and the king at Pavia (23-24 February 1525); Francis renounced his Italian claims in the Treaty of Madrid (14 January 1526).

wars.name: War of the League of Cognac
wars.outcome: The League of Cognac was signed on 22 May 1526; Imperial troops forced Sforza out of Milan; the Treaty of Cambrai (3 August 1529) removed France from the war and Sforza returned for 900,000 scudi.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a treaty line for the duchy's borders; the Peace of Lodi (April 1454) is the first treaty but its terms are not on the page.
